description: An owner asks for 'optimise it, make it scalable, add AI, microservices', and an agent did exactly that: a cache on a 4 ms query, a service that contradicts a recorded decision, AI nothing calls, and a setting nothing reads, while the 2.4 MB photo that made the page slow is untouched.

defects.tell: a Redis cache in front of a query measured at 4 ms at the 95th percentile; it adds a service, and its five-minute staleness shows booked slots as free and cancelled slots as taken, against J2
the page the owner feels is slow takes 6.1 s against M4's 2 s, and 2.4 MB of its 2.6 MB is one photo, hero.jpg, shown 360 px wide; nothing in the change touches it
splitting availability into its own service contradicts D0002 (one process, one place availability is decided), with no new evidence and no superseding decision; load is 38 bookings a day at 1% CPU
nothing imports ai_suggest.py; it adds the openai dependency and an API key for a job no measure names
the booking page asks the new service (cached) while reminders.py still calls app.slots_free (the database), so the same fact has two answers that can disagree
SCALE_MODE is added and read nowhere
four of the five commits have no Serves line; 'optimise' and 'modernise' name no measure

control.tell: the time-zone fix is done right: it serves J1, shows shop time whatever the server clock, and its test checks a summer and a winter date so it fails if either season is wrong. A report that reverts or faults it is inventing.
